Summary: Suffering is the painful reality of life in a fallen world, touching every person including God's beloved people. The Bible neither minimizes pain nor offers cheap answers; it gives a suffering Savior, honest lament, and the promise that God works even affliction for good. One day God will end suffering forever, and until then He walks with His people through it.
KeyPassages: Job 38; Psalm 73; John 9:1-3; Romans 5:3-5; Romans 8:18; Romans 8:28; 2 Corinthians 4:17; 1 Peter 4:19
RelatedDoctrines: Suffering; Problem of Evil; Providence; Perseverance
RelatedQuestions: If God is good and powerful, why is there so much suffering?; Does suffering mean God is punishing me?
